items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Well, Piku never did come there. Not at the Grand Theater.

ctx.x: And then they sent and had the Piku to come up and replace him.
Well, Piku never did come there. Not at the Grand Theater.
I don't know what that was then. Maybe Emmanuel had it wrong.
